I have no idea how to deal with computers, much less a sentient AI that looks like a ham shank.

This is where I upvoted.

I was legitimately disappointed that the Minotaur was just a guy (unless I'm missing a reference to the Minotaur SCP). The climax felt underwhelming because of this — and it's a bit of a truncated ending. If you take advantage of the current editing period, I'd look over that.

This was fun. +1
